title: Tinybird
description: Real-time data analytics platform powered by ClickHouse. Ingest millions of events per second from Kafka or HTTP, query with SQL, and publish instant REST APIs.
features: Native ClickHouse engine optimized for analytical petabyte-scale aggregation
High-throughput event ingestion via Kafka, Kinesis, Google Cloud Pub/Sub, or REST
Transform data using composable SQL pipes with Git version-controlled data projects
Publish parameterized dynamic REST API endpoints with single-digit millisecond latency
Built-in JWT auth, rate limits, and row-level tenant filtering on generated endpoints
pros: Abstracts away massive ClickHouse cluster maintenance and DevOps overhead
Generates blazing fast APIs without writing backend boilerplate
cons: Analytical OLAP engine not suited for transactional OLTP write patterns
Requires SQL optimization skills for optimal materialized view design
targetAudience: Data engineers and full-stack devs building user-facing analytics dashboards and telemetry feeds.
